featured_reviews.name: Ganesh Rajaram
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a very unpleasant bitter experience on the very first day of 2021.
I have been living in Samata Nagar since 1982.
There are 2 shops with the same name located such that .. a few intermediate shops separate them from each other. One sells kids clothes and the other is for grown-ups. Billing is done at the shop selling kids clothes.

They quoted a lesser price while showing the product and charged me nearly Rs180/- more while billing which was promptly done without re-confirming the price. They only warn the customer should satisfy himself about the product size, quality etc as the product is not returnable once billed. But when they actually bill it,  they don't mention or confirm the price deal agreed for. When we say that the quoted price was different,  the  biller says that the buyer must have heard the price incorrectly. The unsuspecting customer who is with his family pays up without complaining as he doesn't want to disappoint / embarrass himself and his family.

I repent having remained silent as I was with my kids there. It was a special day, and I didn't want to spoil it for us..

They sure have a modus operandi,  different from the regular honest shops. All this occurred to me after I left the place,  having hesitatingly but quietly paid for the product for which I was actually told a lesser price.

I have been living in this locality,  even before the 'Idea of Thakur village' was born... The place has better off in earlier days, when it was only a MHADA colony backed up with Damu Nagar. Ever since Thakur Village came up,  the area stinks of ungrateful,  uncivilized and socially reckless unethical crowd...who boast of wealth but are hollow within as human beings.
It seems that the shop has been here ever since Thakur Village came up. I visited the shop, as i had been told by a few guys that the pricing and quality here was reasonable.
So, now it's apparent that the shop has been simply cashing in on the goodwill won by deliberate good price and quality raves spread during initial set up.

Nevertheless, my experience has been very distasteful indeed.

Credibility and morality have vanished amongst business owners these days. Buyers beware.
Thanks.
